annotations.title: Read the feedback on a page

description: Read every comment on an HTMLAnnotate page: what each reviewer said, which element it is pinned to (with a CSS selector), the screen size, suggested text changes and replies. Use it when the user asks what their client said, or wants you to make the requested changes. Needs the page's private manage link (returned by share_html or share_url, or pasted by the user).

include_resolved.description: Also list comments already marked resolved. Default false.
